scenes.text: Ideogram now makes *editable logos* as *real vector files*

scenes.title: What *changed*
lines: Oct 22: Ideogram Vector 1.0. Type a prompt, get one clean SVG you can edit in Illustrator, Figma or Canva.
It also turns a JPG or PNG you already own into a vector.

scenes.title: The *money* use
lines: Logos, stickers and cut files sell as SVGs. Etsy's SVG category is huge, and print shops need vectors.
Prompt: 'Minimal badge logo for a mobile dog groomer, one color, bold, no gradients.' Then clean the paths yourself.

scenes.title: *Tested*, not hyped
lines: The vendor license is not a trademark check. Search the USPTO before you sell a logo.
Etsy's Oct 22 rules want your creative role stated and a real preview. Source: Ideogram, Oct 22; Digital Applied, Oct 23, 2026.

scenes.title: The *cost*
lines: API: 13 to 32 cents per SVG. Image to vector: 10 cents.
App: a free tier with slow credits; Plus is $15 a month for 1,000 credits. Check that your plan includes Vector.

scenes.text: Want the *SVG shop* setup? Comment *VECTOR* and follow.
